applicability: Contributor and release procedures for instruction edits.
conditions: Canonical authored instruction inputs and declared package copies are in scope.
exclusions: The command does not grant release, installation, commit or publication authority.

statement: Contributor and release procedures name the instruction renewal command for instruction facts and package copies.
